title: Refactor Naming Conventions
problem_statement: Inconsistent naming conventions across forms and modules.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased difficulty in maintenance and understanding of the codebase.
suggested_approach: Adopt a consistent naming convention for all forms and modules.
success_criteria: All forms and modules follow the new naming convention.

title: Implement Error Handling
problem_statement: Lack of structured error handling in event handlers.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for unhandled exceptions leading to application crashes.
suggested_approach: Introduce structured error handling using try-catch blocks in C#.
success_criteria: All event handlers have structured error handling.
